newsitem.title: USA: Conrail rejects higher Norfolk Southern bid.
newsitem.headline: Conrail rejects higher Norfolk Southern bid.

text.p: Conrail Inc.'s board Friday rejected Norfolk Southern Corp.'s sweetened $10.5 billion bid in favour of its planned $9.3 billion merger with CSX Inc., the railroad said.

"The Conrail board has again confirmed that a merger of equals with CSX and not a sale to Norfolk Southern is in the best interests of Conrail and its constituencies, including shareholders, employees, suppliers, customers and communities served," company Chairman David LeVan said in a statement.
"The CSX transaction provides extraordinary value to our shareholders which would not have been available without the actions taken by the Conrail board," LeVan said.
CSX Thursday sweetened its proposed cash and stock bid for Conrail by $870 million to about $9.3 billion, or $102 per share.
But, hours later, Norfolk Southern upped its all-cash offer by $500 million to about $10.5 billion, or $115 a share.
CSX and Norfolk Southern have been locked in a takeover battle for Conrail since October.
